sloka: अवाग् शिराः त्रिशंकुः च तिष्ठतु अमर संनिभः ।अनुयास्यन्ति च एतानि ज्योतीन्षि नृप सत्तमम् ॥१-६०-३२॥
transliteration: avāg śirāḥ triśaṁkuḥ ca tiṣṭhatu amara saṁnibhaḥ ।anuyāsyanti ca etāni jyotīnṣi nṛpa sattamam ॥1-60-32॥

translations.english: These stars will follow this illustrious one (Trisanku), the best of kings who gained his object, as if he had attained heaven.
